description: Recall where the previous session left off: recent turns, checkpoints, and open work.

max_content_bytes.description: Per-turn content cap in bytes (256-262144, default 8192)

since.description: Time-range floor: epoch seconds, RFC 3339, or YYYY-MM-DD

until.description: Time-range ceiling: epoch seconds, RFC 3339, or YYYY-MM-DD

name: session.continuity

outputSchema.description: Recent turns plus the latest checkpoint handoff for the prior session.

checkpoint_id.description: Memory UUID of the checkpoint, or null

previous_session.description: Session the turns were read from

truncated.description: Whether the response hit its byte budget

turns.description: Turns (memory_id, role, turn_type, sequence, content, content_bytes, content_truncated, importance)

turns_omitted.description: Turns dropped by the response budget

title: Recall session continuity
